subject: Clarify invoice ownership, net terms, and min-commit proration (Order Form redlines)
messages:
From: Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@datawave.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Miles Chen <miles.chen@datawave.com>, procurement@datawave.com
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines - billing & tax questions

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for sending back the redlines. Our legal team flagged a few outstanding commercial items we need to resolve before we can proceed:

1) Invoice ownership / routing: the redline still shows Redwood issuing a single consolidated invoice to DataWave, but we need to confirm whether DataWave can request split invoices by BU (two invoice recipients). Will Redwood support split invoices for the same Order Form and allow separate POs on each invoice?

2) Net terms: Your earlier draft had NET45; our procurement prefers NET60. Can Redwood accommodate NET60 on this deal or offer a short extension window tied to payment milestones?

3) Minimum commit proration: We requested proration language for the minimum committed units if onboarding is delayed; legal wants explicit math and an example. Can you provide sample proration language and a simple worked example for a partial-month ramp?

4) Taxes & evidence: DataWave requires that Redwood provide VAT registration evidence and country-level tax responsibility clauses. Who will be responsible for VAT where DataWave is the consuming party?

I've attached our annotated Order Form (DataWave_OrderForm_Redlines.pdf). Can we aim to close commercial terms this week? If helpful, I can put Miles (finance) on a quick call.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Turner
Sr. Procurement Manager | DataWave Inc
Attachment: DataWave_OrderForm_Redlines.pdf (PDF, 412KB)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@datawave.com>
Cc: Miles Chen <miles.chen@datawave.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines - billing & tax questions

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list and for the redlines. I pulled in Sales Ops, Finance, and Legal so we can give definitive answers. Initial responses below; we can refine language and share a tracked doc by EOD.

1) Invoice split: We can support split invoices on the same Order Form up to two invoice recipients with separate PO numbers. We'll need the invoice recipient names and billing addresses on execution. For split invoices there is a 1% operational fee (to cover bank reconciliation) — I know that might be new, so open to discussing a waiver depending on seat volume.

2) Net terms: Our standard is NET45; Finance (cc’d) can review NET60 if DataWave is willing to accept either (a) payment guarantee via PO confirmation or (b) an initial prepayment equal to the first full month of committed units.

3) Proration example: See attached Redwood_Response_Redlines_v1.docx for suggested clause and worked example (we prorate on a per-day basis using calendar days; partial months are rounded to two decimals). Example: 30-day month, customer starts on day 11 with 100-seat monthly commit -> billed commit = 100 * (20/30) = 66.67 seats for first invoice.

4) Taxes: We are registered for VAT in the UK and EU; we will provide registration evidence and WHT docs where requested. For consumption in DataWave’s jurisdiction: Redwood will apply taxes in accordance with local law; the Order Form will include a clause assigning statutory tax liability to the customer except where Redwood is required by law to collect and remit.

Next steps:
- Ben will propose specific Order Form language for invoice split + 1% fee or waiver.
- Aditya will confirm NET60 feasibility and any finance prepayment options.
- Monica will update the Order Form pricing schedule to reflect split-invoice flow and proration math.

Can you confirm target invoice recipients and whether DataWave will accept the 1% split-invoice fee or prefer Redwood to absorb? If you prefer a call, happy to schedule tomorrow.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Direct: (415) 555-0178
Attachment: Redwood_Response_Redlines_v1.docx (DOCX, 95KB)

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Net terms / invoice-split feasibility (DataWave)

Lauren / team — quick finance input:

- NET60: We can accept NET60 but with these conditions: 1) initial invoice must be paid NET30 for the first billing cycle OR 2) DataWave provides an irrevocable PO-confirmation for the committed amount. NET60 increases DSO exposure materially; with forecasted ARR here (~$480k ARR first year) we can accept only with one of those mitigations.

- Invoice split: Operationally fine for two recipients; we need clear mapping rules in the Order Form: a line-item prefix (BU-A / BU-B) that ties committed units to invoice recipient. Finance will require separate invoice numbers and separate GL mappings. If DataWave expects >2 splits, that's not supported without custom billing.

- Tax handling: We will include a clause: "Customer is responsible for taxes arising from their use of Services unless Redwood is legally obligated to collect and remit such taxes." We will attach VAT registration docs to the DocuSign packet.

If you want, I can draft the exact clause and sample invoice table (per BU split) for Monica to paste into the Order Form.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Oct 2027 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines - draft edits for invoice routing & proration

Attaching a working playbook and suggested redline snippets (Proposed_Invoice_Split_Playbook.pdf). Key changes I propose:

- Invoice split snippet: "Redwood may issue up to two (2) invoices per billing cycle for the Order Form. Customer must designate Invoice Recipient A and Invoice Recipient B with separate PO numbers. Redwood will apply a 1% invoice-splitting fee unless waived in writing by Redwood in the Order Form."

- Proration snippet: "For any partial month in which the Service Commences, charges for committed units will be prorated on a per-calendar-day basis: (Committed units) * (Remaining days in month / Total days in month). Example provided in Exhibit A."

- Billing cadence: For split invoices, Redwood will aggregate usage at month-end and then issue separate invoices within 3 business days. For net terms: propose Redwood accepts NET60 if DataWave provides PO confirmation or prepays 1x first month. If DataWave requests NET60 without PO confirm, add 3% late credit right of recovery clause.

Ben — please confirm legal is comfortable with the 1% language and the late-credit fallback.

Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Proposed_Invoice_Split_Playbook.pdf (PDF, 128KB)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@datawave.com>, Miles Chen <miles.chen@datawave.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Finalized responses + next steps (Order Form DW-2027-089)

Hi Sarah / Miles — thanks for the quick turnaround. Pulling together the team answers and next steps below.

Summary of agreed positions (updated redline will be uploaded to the drive and DocuSign):
- Invoice split: Redwood will support up to two (2) separate invoice recipients on the same Order Form. Customer must provide recipient names and billing addresses at signature. Redwood will apply a 1% invoice-splitting operational fee unless waived in writing; Redwood can consider waiving for deals >$500k ARR.

- NET terms: Redwood standard NET45. Redwood will accept NET60 provided DataWave either (A) provides an irrevocable PO confirmation for committed units or (B) prepays an amount equal to the first full month of committed units. If DataWave chooses NET60 without PO confirmation, Redwood requests a short grace-credit clause (we will discuss exact language).

- Proration: Redwood will prorate committed units on a per-calendar-day basis and round to two decimals. Example is included in Exhibit A of the attached doc.

- Taxes: Redwood will supply VAT registration evidence for EU/UK and will include a tax-responsibility clause assigning statutory tax liabilities to the customer except where Redwood is legally obliged to collect and remit.

Ask from DataWave: Please confirm the two invoice recipients and whether you accept a 1% split fee or would like Redwood to waive based on deal size. If you accept NET60, confirm which mitigation you prefer (PO confirmation or 1x month prepayment).

I attached the working redline (Redwood_Response_Redlines_v1.docx) and Monica’s playbook. For execution, I’ve included a DocuSign link where we’ll attach VAT docs and the final order form: https://app.docusign.com/ABC-DEF-123

If everything looks good, target signature by Oct 10 so onboarding can begin Oct 20. Happy to jump on a 20-min call this afternoon if you want to walk through.

Best regards,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0178
